Read the Overview and Rules tabs (eligibility, submission caps, runtime limits, prize rules).
Download the ARC-AGI-2 data from the Data tab and build a model capable of novel reasoning.

Track the public leaderboard; top placements on the final leaderboard earn a share of the $700,000 prize pool.
